content: If a bus of a coordination cluster has the parameter NmChannel- SleepMaster set to TRUE , the NM Coordinator shall consider that bus ready to sleep at all times and shall not await an invocation of Nm_RemoteSleepIndication from that bus before starting shutdown of that network.
